profile.name: Ahmad Syamim bin Mohd Nizam
profile.title: Computer Science Student · DevOps & Infrastructure
profile.summary: Final-year CS student at UiTM Shah Alam, specialising in DevOps. I build automated CI/CD pipelines and containerised deployments, and run a self-hosted Debian server with 8+ Dockerised services behind a hardened Nginx stack and Cloudflare Tunnel, monitored with Prometheus and Grafana. Strong security foundation: my pipelines integrate SAST and container scanning. Available for a 14-week internship from 7th September to 11th December 2026.

projects.name: Debian Homeserver
projects.description: Self-hosted Debian server running 8+ Dockerised services behind a hardened Nginx reverse proxy and layered network security, with private VPN access and a Cloudflare Tunnel exposing zero inbound ports.

projects.name: TaskFlow
projects.description: MERN task manager with a security-gated CI/CD pipeline: five scanners (Semgrep SAST, Gitleaks secrets, and Trivy across SCA, image, and IaC) block deploy on HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

projects.name: Portfolio Website
projects.description: Data-driven CV and one-page resume served from a single REST API, auto-deployed by a GitHub Actions pipeline to a self-hosted server and published through a Cloudflare Tunnel.

projects.name: Student Reminder System
projects.description: Flutter timetable and push-notification app for UiTM students, backed by a Dockerised FastAPI service.

projects.name: BeanThere
projects.description: Coffee shop web app: online ordering, loyalty rewards, AI drink recommender, and a full CI/CD pipeline with security scanning on a self-hosted server.
